name: Sink gasket 30 / 51, rim 3
description: The sink gasket changed as asked: inner diameter 30 mm (was 31) and the rim 3 mm high (was 5). Outer diameter 51 mm, flat web 1.2 mm thick, flat out to a radius of about 23.4 mm, then a straight 45 degree ramp up to the rim; the top side is rounded where the web turns up. The underside has a sharp 45 degree bend, so it prints without supports. Print in TPU, flat side down. The original 31 / 51 gasket is kept. Assumed: the rim being 2 mm lower means its height 5 to 3 mm, with the same web thickness and the same 45 degree ramp. Not printed or fitted.
